verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is the core of Sai. Users 'describe the work in plain English and Sai does it' (simular-docs-14). The API accepts tasks 'in plain language' (simular-docs-1). Workflow templates are ready-to-run prompts (simular-docs-23), and saving a replayable skill is itself done with a plain-English instruction (simular-docs-8). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably as claimed.
